policy: This benchmark is the agreed review contract for the LE Lab domain-relevance gate. Cases are append-only: existing cases are never edited or removed, and new cases enter only by explicit agreement between the maintainer and the reviewer, in a commit that changes no classifier code. Gold labels were chosen to be unambiguous to a careful human reader; deliberately borderline passages were excluded, because the gate's fail-open triage UI (visible set-asides plus per-passage overrides) is the designed handling for genuinely uncertain text. The gate is deterministic lexical triage: meeting these thresholds does not claim open-world generalization, and a fresh adversarial paraphrase falling outside these families is expected occasionally to misclassify — visibly and reversibly, never as silent data loss.

labels.retain: The gate must keep the passage in analysis (status relevant or uncertain).
labels.ignore: The gate must set the passage aside (status irrelevant).

domainRecall.meaning: Share of expected-retain cases actually retained. Guards against silent loss of relationship-domain claims.

ignorePrecision.meaning: Of everything the gate sets aside, the share that is genuinely non-domain. Guards against the gate binning real claims.

junkRecall.meaning: Share of expected-ignore cases actually set aside. Quality metric: misses are retained in the fail-open direction, visible in the triage-labeled ledger, and excludable by hand. May only be raised, never lowered.

achievedAtFreeze.note: Measured against the classifier at freeze time (2026-07-26). Every junkRecall miss at freeze was a fail-open retention of a polysemous trap; none was silent.
